svg.title: Median Lighthouse performance score, mobile
svg.desc: Median Lighthouse performance score (0 to 100) of mobile origins detected for WordPress, Drupal, Joomla, Webflow, Wix, Squarespace and Ghost, monthly from 2020-01 to 2026-09 (HTTP Archive Tech Report). Lab scores, so levels are low for every CMS; compare the direction of each line. Colours are assigned by position in this figure.

text.tspan: Source: HTTP Archive Tech Report (cdn.httparchive.org/v1/lighthouse); retrieved 2026-10-29. Lab data, median over origins. Raw data:
scripts/cms-comparison-charts/data/performance.csv. See the Bibliography for the sources.
